name: course-notes-preview
description: A live, side-by-side preview for math-heavy Markdown course notes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The preview intentionally renders raw HTML and CSS from the open workspace.

courseNotesPreview.noteFiles.description: Markdown files in section order, relative to the workspace root. This controls section numbering and cross-file equation references.

courseNotesPreview.workspaceCssFiles.description: CSS files to apply to the preview, relative to the workspace root.

courseNotesPreview.autoNumberCallouts.description: Automatically number result boxes and labeled equations by section, and fill in numbered cross-references.

courseNotesPreview.openCollapsedProofs.description: Open collapsible proof and subproof blocks when they first appear in the preview.

courseNotesPreview.updateDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after an edit before refreshing the preview.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check media/source-navigation.js && node --check media/equation-numbering.js && node --check media/equation-reference-index.js && node --check media/code-blocks.js && node --check media/preview.js && node --test test/*.test.js
